name: friendly
label: Friendly
css: .style-friendly { background-color: var(--slide-surface, #FFFFFF); border-radius: 24px; padding: 60px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: flex-start; width: 1080px; height: 1080px; box-sizing: border-box; position: relative; font-family: 'Noto Serif Display', serif; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); } .style-friendly .hook { font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); max-width: 90%; word-break: break-word; } .style-friendly .text { font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); max-width: 85%; margin-top: 20px; } .style-friendly .step { position: absolute; top: 60px; right: 60px; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); opacity: 0.08; line-height: 1; } .style-friendly .brand { position: absolute; bottom: 60px; left: 60px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); letter-spacing: 0.5px; } .style-friendly::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; border-radius: 24px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--slide-primary, #F2D9DC) 0%, transparent 50%); opacity: 0.05; pointer-events: none; } .slide-code.style-friendly { background-color: #1F2937; color: #F3F4F6; } .slide-code.style-friendly .hook { color: #F3F4F6; } .slide-code.style-friendly .text { color: #E5E7EB; } .slide-code.style-friendly .step { color: #F3F4F6; opacity: 0.12; } .slide-code.style-friendly .brand { color: #D1D5DB; } .slide-code.style-friendly::before { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--slide-primary, #F2D9DC) 0%, transparent 50%); opacity: 0.08; } .slide-insight.style-friendly { background-color: #111827; color: #F3F4F6; } .slide-insight.style-friendly .hook { color: var(--slide-primary, #F2D9DC); } .slide-insight.style-friendly .text { color: #F3F4F6; } .slide-insight.style-friendly .insight-text { font-size: 44px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; color: #FFFFFF; max-width: 88%; margin-top: 24px; } .slide-insight.style-friendly .step { color: var(--slide-primary, #F2D9DC); opacity: 0.15; } .slide-insight.style-friendly .brand { color: #D1D5DB; } .slide-insight.style-friendly::before { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--slide-primary, #F2D9DC) 0%, transparent 50%); opacity: 0.1; }
